title: orobanche uniflora var. minuta
intro: Orobanche uniflora var. minuta, commonly known as dwarf broomrape, is a parasitic plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche uniflora var. minuta are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
